Formal Weyl lifts, scalar mate obstructions, finite centralizers and exact quantum division spectra.

**Authored assessment:** All-order formal lifting, low-order DC1 automorphisms and scoped obstructions remain internally established. Canonical graded scalar Long lifts require spatial degree at least 27 with arbitrary parity and 28 for even Moyal symbols; degree 27 is the sharp minimum through h5. The admitted XQ Airy source datum gives a matrix jet through h4 at degree 25, but its entire prescribed-first-coefficient family fails at h5 through degree 26. Three crossing coordinates give a one-order covariant correction test without a uniform bound. Actual polynomial Ore intertwiners obey strict mixed-corner descent in the stated rectangle, while the corrected primary DC1 comparison still leaves absolute subprincipal and global-admission constraints open. No bounded full Long lift or DC1/DC2 resolution is obtained.

## Arithmetic fibres, discriminants and restricted-prime sums

Constructive finite etale fibres, arithmetic failures and discriminant geometry. Restricted-prime sums and primitive Eisenstein norm sumsets have a separate internally complete manuscript.

**Authored assessment:** The exact elliptic six-prime coefficient is 2081912199403/9893175318390; the certified-field coefficient is 13361/114520. The proved two-primary Sha vanishing and all-prime Selmer parity make dim Sha[p] even without assuming Sha finite. Outside finite exceptions, the actual class-group multiplicity c_p recovers dim Sha[p]=2 floor((c_p-1)/2); a third copy occurs exactly when Sha[p] is nonzero. Serre and uniform Kummer theory give open adelic affine image. Every fixed good-order Fourier mode now has arithmetic factoring-density bounds, and projected averaged pole measures converge weakly to an equivalent-Haar measure with positive L2 density. Growing-order tails, recurrence and Hasse infinitude remain open. Eventual Eisenstein equal-thirds balance also has an independent finite-polynomial proof. The coordinate-tail counterexample shows why Ro, rather than n, is the required sieve normalization. EisPower now proves ordinary and mixed power-window existence with exponent99/100 above2^(2^411). For simultaneous C12 support, S12U is the first every-target goal; the new pointwise upper bounds and fixed-cutoff tail leave the natural lower count and fixed-prime marginals open. Full semigroup-scale FBS-U and sharp thin energy remain open. The renewed uniform-Hecke audit and self-contained triangle/annulus proof upgrade EisPower to every fixed2/3<theta<1 with explicit onsets; Jackson-Parseval independently gives the intermediate theta>6/7 range. The original99/100 full witness count is preserved. The central exponent endpoint, exact finite exceptions and both C12 pointwise inputs remain open. EisValueCounts now gives every-target logarithmic unweighted Eisenstein counts at 2/3<theta<1. VqPower proves quantitative full-count variance and sharp energy for fixedtheta>5/6; the residual equivalent frontier is0<theta<=5/6. Divisor-truncation diagnostics are proved, while C12 pointwise inputs, every-target goals, effectivity and priority remain open. D12Power now gives a power-saving lower-count exceptional set at q12,theta=.99. The exact all-target C12 assertions, norm pointwise inputs, full-count power-saving variance and priority remain open. EisSemigroupScale now proves expected q3 pointwise count comparability for wide powers and central macro windows. SimNormPower supplies full weighted raw/good correlations and actual marginals outside power exceptional sets, including complete moving fixed intervals. Smaller q3 powers, all-target C12, unweighted residual/full power-saving variance and priority remain open. EisLocationWindows now gives uniform moving-position counts and every fixed macroscopic interval at the expected q3 scale; a designated small summand has the strict power range theta>1/2, while central powers still require theta > 2/3. Coprime subgroup-coset compression and an explicit nonmultiplicative Fourier-gap family are separately scoped. EisJointCosetDistribution now gives all-valuation joint finite/archimedean distribution with one tau factor and stronger summed cofactor levels. FixedPeriodicBoxes proves a bounded period-12 divisor-box transfer beyond square-root level. SimNormOddDilation and SimNormDeepDilation are equivalences assuming only the stated positivity. AsymPointwise proves a weighted every-target C12+A3 convolution and a one-sided N^(1-epsilon) value-count corollary. The full C12+C12 goal and its pointwise lower/marginal inputs remain open. AsymUniform now supplies the small-power coefficient/shift interface, and AsymSemigroupScale proves every-target C12+A3 comparability at N J_E(N)/(log N)^(5/4). The half-dimensional route has exact local mass, parity and kernel compression, but its beyond-half signed remainder remains open. Critical switching now gives an unconditional all-target upper bound for the two-large-prime bad survivors. Its critical-level conditional criterion lowers a sufficient distribution target to N^(1/2) times a negative logarithmic power; that absolute or signed remainder remains open. The earlier beyond-half remainder is retained as an alternative, and full C12/H1/H2 remain open. The fixed-modulus asymmetric theory now gives weighted and tiny-coefficient results and the unrestricted unweighted logarithmic count for each fixed q and quadratic chi. Its bounded-excluded-prime bridge reaches the full two-sided logarithmic scale without removing every excluded factor when phi(q) > 2. The auxiliary average now gives a full positive L1 divisor level below a fixed xi chosen before its smaller error saving. Critical square-root distribution, full C12/Cq two-sided goals beyond the stated baselines, H1/H2 and priority remain open. The subgroup theorem now treats nonnested abelian splitting sets, with exact finite residue admissibility and a target product only outside both allowed sets. Its C4+C3 specialization gives the mixed quadratic count, while two extra half-dimensional exclusions would be needed for C12+C12. Exact sign transfer retains the target main and a fixed-period replacement has full-order squared error; these obstructions do not settle the critical remainder. A quaternary deduction now gives eventual local-global existence for two separately primitive binary forms; both exact -8 and -11 self-sum classifications are proved.
